blocks.text: Hybrid cloud public aur private clouds ko mila deti hai, aur data aur applications dono ke darmiyan share ho sakti hain. Yeh model zyada lachak (flexibility) aur control deta hai.

Misal (Example): ek company rozmarra ke kaam ke liye public cloud aur hassas (sensitive) data ke liye private cloud istemal kar sakti hai. Masroof dinon mein barhe hue bojh (load) ko sambhalne ke liye woh kam hassas data aur applications public cloud par le jati hai, jabke aham (critical) data private cloud mein mehfooz rehta hai.

blocks.prompt: Kaunsa deployment model public aur private cloud dono ki khoobiyan milata hai (exercise MCQ 6)?
Kaunse deployment model mein resources aise kai idaron mein share hote hain jin ke maqasid (concerns) ek jaise hon (exercise MCQ 2)?
blocks.explanation: (c) Community Cloud. Yeh model chapter mein bayan nahi hua; community cloud woh cloud hai jo ek jaisi zarooraton wale kai idare (maslan kai hospitals ya sarkari mahkame) mil kar istemal karte hain. Kitab ki answer key bhi (c) deti hai.

items: Hybrid cloud: public + private; data aur apps dono ke darmiyan aa ja sakti hain.
Rozmarra kaam public par, aham data private mein.
